title: A regional freight carrier cut morning dispatch planning from 2.5 hours to 25 minutes

summary.text: A dispatch console, a driver app and a route optimiser replaced spreadsheet planning and phone-based dispatch across 3 depots and 64 trucks.

challenge.text: A regional freight carrier runs 64 trucks from 3 depots and completes about 340 deliveries per day.
Every morning, 5 dispatchers rebuilt the next day's routes in three shared spreadsheets, a process that took about 2.5 hours and often sent trucks out late.
Late departures cascaded into missed delivery windows: the on-time rate was 81%, and trucks ran empty on 18% of route kilometres.
With no visibility for customers, the office fielded around 120 "where is my truck?" calls a day, and dispatchers spent their time on the phone instead of planning.
Paper proof of delivery meant disputes took days to resolve.

solution.text: A web dispatch console with a drag-and-drop route board and a live map of every truck.
A route optimiser that respects customer time windows and driver hours and suggests backhauls for return legs, while dispatchers keep the final say.
A driver app with photo and signature proof of delivery and an offline mode for rural routes with poor coverage.
Automatic ETA messages to customers by SMS and email, with LLM-drafted text checked against a fixed template before sending.
A pilot at one depot came first: the MVP was live after 9 weeks and all 3 depots after 14 weeks.

results.text: Morning planning now takes about 25 minutes for the whole fleet, down from about 2.5 hours.
Customer status calls fell from 120 to about 30 per day.
61 of 64 drivers were using the app within two weeks of the all-depot rollout.

stack.text: Next.js and TypeScript — web dispatch console
Flutter — Android and iOS driver app
NestJS, PostgreSQL and PostGIS — API and geospatial queries
Python and Google OR-Tools — vehicle routing with time windows
Docker on AWS ECS Fargate with RDS for PostgreSQL — hosting

quote.text: For the first time in years, my dispatchers go home on time and the phones are quiet.
